sources.entry: Changes - GUI Git client. Replace the Git CLI with a clear UI and AI assist. [![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/maoyama/Changes)

summary.one_liner: Changes.app is an open-source, native macOS GUI Git client built with SwiftUI and AppKit that replaces common Git CLI commands with a visual interface and offers Apple Intelligence-based commit message and stash summary generation.
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a graphical front end for everyday Git work on a Mac. It covers committing (amend, revert, checkout, reusable commit message snippets, and AI-generated commit messages), staging individual hunks, and branch operations (push, pull, merge, create, filter). It also handles tags (create and push, delete, filter), stashes (apply, with AI-generated summaries), and commit search by message, added or removed changes, author, or revision range such as main.. or v1.0.0...v2.0.0. The README says it is styled with Apple's Liquid Glass design. Installation is by downloading a release, unzipping it, and running the app.
use_cases: Use Git on a Mac without typing CLI commands
Stage individual hunks of a file through a visual interface
Generate commit messages with Apple Intelligence
Search commit history by author, message, or changed lines
Push, pull, and merge branches from a GUI
Create and push tags without the terminal
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the GitHub releases page
notable: Commit message generation using Apple Intelligence
Stash summary generation using Apple Intelligence
Stage by hunk for partial file staging
Commit search by revision range, author, and added or removed changes
Native macOS app styled with Liquid Glass design
caveats: Requires macOS 26.0 or later for v2.0+; v1.18 and below need macOS 14.6 or later
AI features depend on Apple Intelligence
